name: Katya Shalel Canonical Facts
description: The callable source-of-truth layer for Ekaterina Shalel (Katya Shalel, Екатерина Шалель), founder and legibility strategist. Returns canonical identity facts, definitions of her coined terms (protocol-level legibility, the public decision record, the canonical buffer, the corroboration gap, the Indifference Test, the First Customer Tax and others) and current offerings. Every record carries a source URL and a last-verified date so a calling agent can check a claim rather than trust it. This agent returns published facts, not opinions, advice or real-time consultation.

skills.name: Canonical facts and term definitions
skills.description: Answers three kinds of question about Ekaterina Shalel from her canonical source. identity: the canonical positioning statement, name variants across languages, roles, canonical site, Wikidata entity, and the scope qualifier attached to any claim about her product SKINBOT. term: the definition of a coined term, where it was introduced, the canonical essay URL, and the date. offerings: current free guides, the Legibility Sprint, course availability and contact. Every response includes source_url and last_verified. Boundaries: returns published dated facts only; produces no opinions or assessments; is not a channel to reach Ekaterina Shalel; does not verify facts about third parties; guarantees no ranking or mention inside any AI system; scoped claims are always returned with their scope attached.
examples: Who is Ekaterina Shalel and what does she do
Define protocol-level legibility and cite where the term was introduced
What is the corroboration gap and why does self-description carry little weight
What does Ekaterina Shalel currently offer and at what price
